title: IAM display search must decode both RESOURCE_TABLE and FIELD_VALUES response formats
answers: How do I decode a ResourceSearchResponse for display/avatar lookups?
Why does display search still handle the old table format?
User/service-account search shows blank names against older Grafana servers
body:
Symptom: display search (user/service-account title, email, login, legacy ID) breaks or returns empty names when talking to a server on a different version.
Root cause: pkg/registry/apis/iam/display/search.go previously assumed ResourceSearchResponse always carried the RESOURCE_TABLE shape (Results.Columns/Rows); newer servers can return FIELD_VALUES (Fields + Rows[].Values) instead.
Fix pattern: decodeDisplayRows switches on rsp.GetResultFormat() and routes to decodeDisplayTableRows (column-index + cellAt byte parsing) for UNSPECIFIED/RESOURCE_TABLE, or resource.DecodeSearchValues(rsp.Fields, row) for FIELD_VALUES, into a common displaySearchRow struct before building iam.Display items.
Constraints: apply this dual-decode pattern whenever a client sets ResultFormat: FIELD_VALUES on a ResourceSearchRequest but must stay compatible with servers that only emit RESOURCE_TABLE; an unrecognized ResultFormat should return an error rather than silently decoding wrong.
applies: pkg/registry/apis/iam/display/search.go and any caller of resourcepb.ResourceSearchRequest that sets ResultFormat

The decoding switches on rsp.GetResultFormat() to route to decodeDisplayTableRows for column-indexed byte parsing (UNSPECIFIED/RESOURCE_TABLE) or resource.DecodeSearchValues for FIELD_VALUES format, then builds a common displaySearchRow struct. Applies when a client sets ResultFormat: FIELD_VALUES on a ResourceSearchRequest to maintain compatibility with servers emitting only RESOURCE_TABLE; unrecognized ResultFormat must error rather than silently decode wrong. Handles display-name fields (user/service-account title, email, login, legacy ID) that break when talking to different-versioned servers.
